title: FAQ 架構基礎 — Prisma 模型 + 管理端 API
content:
DECOMPOSED — this card has been split into 5 sub-cards. Do not implement from this card.

Sub-cards:
- AF-001-A: Prisma Schema — Rename Faq→CourseFaq + Add GeneralFaqCategory & GeneralFaq models + seed + update all rename references
- AF-001-B: Admin FAQ Categories CRUD API (GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE)
- AF-001-C: Admin FAQ CRUD API (GET paginated/POST/PATCH/DELETE)
- AF-001-D: Public FAQ API (GET published FAQs grouped by category, no auth)
- AF-001-E: CourseFaq standalone API routes for course edit page (GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE under /api/admin/courses/[courseId]/faqs)

Original scope:
- Faq → CourseFaq rename + GeneralFaqCategory + GeneralFaq models in Prisma
- Admin CRUD routes for categories and FAQs
- Public GET /api/faq grouped by category
- Zod validation, admin auth checks, seed data

comments.name: Agent
comments.text: Decomposed into 4 sub-cards (AF-001-A through AF-001-D) after plan discussion revealed the card touches 16 files across Prisma schema rename, validation, admin API, and public API.

acceptance: Prisma migration creates GeneralFaqCategory and GeneralFaq tables with all specified fields
GET /api/admin/faq/categories returns all categories ordered by `order`
POST/PATCH/DELETE admin category routes work with proper auth check
GET /api/admin/faq returns paginated FAQs with category relation
POST/PATCH/DELETE admin FAQ routes work with Zod validation
GET /api/faq returns published FAQs grouped by category (public, no auth)
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
files: prisma/schema.prisma (update — rename Faq→CourseFaq, add GeneralFaqCategory + GeneralFaq)
prisma/seed.ts (update — rename references, add sample general FAQ data)
src/app/api/faq/route.ts (new — public GET grouped by category)
verification: npx prisma migrate dev --name add_faq_models && npm run typecheck && curl GET /api/faq returns published FAQs grouped by category. Admin CRUD routes work with valid auth token.
